envelope.text: here throws, so that case also returns the `NOT_SET` parameter

why:
issue 2080 -- both upstream overloads, as static members of `ParameterEventHandler`, each a TEMPLATE over the event type: there is no runtime typesupport, so the C++ surface cannot name `rcl_interfaces::msg::ParameterEvent`, and the type is DEDUCED from the argument -- the caller's generated message (inline `FixedString`/`FixedSequence` or heap `HeapString` fields, or `std::string`). An upstream call site (`ParameterEventHandler::get_parameter_from_event(event, p, name, node)`) compiles unchanged once that header is included. Same lookup as upstream: `event.node` compared verbatim to `node_name` (default ""), then new, then changed parameters; deletions are not reported. The bound, from no exceptions: where upstream THROWS `std::runtime_error` on a node-name mismatch, the value overload returns `Parameter(name)` (`PARAMETER_NOT_SET`), the same as a missing name -- the `bool` overload tells the two apart. Hosted only, like the handler. Held by `parameter_event_from_event_runtime.cpp` in `just check cpp`.
